doc.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015

title: How Ruth and Bucky met at St. Joseph's Hospital
summary: Ruth tells of meeting Bucky when he came to see his sister Marie, their first date, and her mother's worry about musicians and Gene Krupa.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: My sister was a nurse at St. Joe’s Hospital. And she was working at the emergency room. And Ruth baby here, was there too.
I worked there with his sister.
So she saw me and she fell in love with me.
I thought we’d get a couple of those moments here. Okay so Ruth, how did you meet?

I was a registered nurse at St. Joseph’s Hospital in Paterson, New Jersey, and I had just graduated. It was in 1951, ’52, something like that. And I happened to look — I was on duty and I happened to look up, and sitting on the bench, they had a little bench outside the admitting department. And I had to go out and say, “may I help you.” So I walked out and this wonderful looking man, oh beautifully dressed, and I went out and I said, “may I help you.” And he said, “I’m waiting for my sister, Marie Pizzarelli.” “Oh, yes, just a moment please.” So I went back and I said, “Marie, is that your brother?” And she said, “oh is he here?” “Oh, okay.” Left it go. Next day he was back again. So I walked out. Because Marie told me he was a celebrity. So I walked out and said, “your sister told me

you’re a celebrity and you worked with Vaughan Monroe, my favorite, my sister and I.” It was bliss. And so after that I was still living in the nursing school home and the phone rang while I was waiting for my brother to come pick me up to go home. And the phone rang, and it was Marie saying, and I happened to be there — I went to the phone, Marie said, “oh Ruth, my brother wants to talk to you” meaning Mr. Pizzarelli. He said, “hi Ruth, would you like to go out tonight?” I said, “oh I’d love to but I can’t go because my brother is picking me up with his car to take me home.” And you know what Bucky said? “Tell him to go home.” So I did. And that was our first date. And it was wonderful. Everything was good. My mother gave us a little trouble, because he was a musician, and marijuana was in the thing. And Gene Krupa.
Gene Krupa. He had been arrested.
